secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. OpenAI API key for the OpenAI provider (platform.openai.com/api-keys). Not needed for the default local Ollama provider.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Google Gemini API key for the Gemini provider (aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). Not needed for the default local Ollama provider.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Anthropic Claude API key for the Claude provider (console.anthropic.com/settings/keys). Not needed for the default local Ollama provider.
